tools.name: list_projects
tools.description:
List all projects accessible with this API key. Use this to find project IDs for other tools.

**Start here** to discover which projects you can work with.

tools.name: get_agent_instructions
tools.description: Get the canonical Damper workflow instructions. Use this to set up or update CLAUDE.md in a project.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description:
Get roadmap tasks. Returns backlog/planned/in-progress by default. Search by title, description, plan, user story, or exact label, and filter by type, quarter, etc. Use `query` before paginating when checking whether a matching task already exists.

Returns up to 50 tasks by default. Response includ

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get task details. Defaults to a compact view (plan, current progress, subtasks, PRs, unresolved decisions, completion receipt, evidence counts) — no `agentNotes` dump. Pass `detailMode: "full"` for the legacy full payload (agentNotes, all sessions/commits inline), or request specific sections on dem

tools.name: list_self_assessments
tools.description: List recent structured agent self-assessments for a project. Use this miss log to find recurring missingContext/toolIssues/processGaps and improve project context.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update task fields like description, implementation plan, priority, effort, quarter, start/due dates, labels, or visibility. Pass status "closed" to discard a task that will not ship. Useful for refining task details as you learn more about the work. Set startDate and dueDate when planning so the ta

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new roadmap task. Use for importing from TODO files or creating work items. When the task comes from customer feedback, pass `feedbackIds` to link it in the same call: the feedback status follows the task and followers are notified, the same as linking later with `link_feedback_to_task`. Un

tools.name: add_note
tools.description:
Add a note to a task, or resolve a previously reported blocker/open_question. Use ONLY for non-obvious approach decisions and blockers — do not restate commits, checklist confirmations, or self-assessment findings here; those are already stored structurally and shown in `get_task`.

**Do NOT use for

tools.name: add_commit
tools.description:
Log a commit for a task (secondary detail — the linked pull request is the primary deliverable, see `link_pr`).

**When to use:**
- After a notable commit: log hash and message
- When completing work: optionally pass commits to complete_task instead

**Example:** After `git commit`, call this with t

tools.name: link_pr
tools.description:
Link the pull request that delivers this task. The PR is the primary deliverable of a task — call this as soon as the PR exists, and call it again with `state: "merged"` after merge. Upserts by URL, so repeated calls update the same PR record.

**When to use:**
- Right after opening a PR for the tas

tools.name: create_subtask
tools.description: Add a new subtask to a task. Useful for breaking down work into smaller steps. Optionally set startDate/dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD) so the subtask appears on the roadmap timeline.

tools.name: update_subtask
tools.description: Update a subtask: mark it done/not done and/or set its timeline dates. Use get_task to see subtask IDs. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; null clears a date.

tools.name: delete_subtask
tools.description: Remove a subtask from a task. Use get_task to see subtask IDs.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Only works on tasks in backlog or planned status with no commits.

tools.name: add_task_dependency
tools.description: Add a dependency between roadmap tasks. The blocker task must be done before the blocked task can be worked on. Provide either blockerId (this task is blocked by another) or blockedId (this task blocks another).

tools.name: remove_task_dependency
tools.description: Remove a task dependency by dependency ID.

tools.name: add_api_example
tools.description:
Attach a request/response example for an API endpoint you added or changed, so the reviewer can check the contract in Damper without running anything. Add one per changed endpoint (more for distinct cases, e.g. success and validation error — give each its own `key`).

**Upserts by key:** the key def

tools.name: add_screenshot
tools.description: Attach a screenshot of a page or screen you added or changed, so the reviewer sees the result in Damper. Capture every changed page in each relevant state (default, empty, loading, error, validation…), using the locale/theme/viewport the project asks for (see start_task). Give each state its own cal

tools.name: add_diagram
tools.description: Attach a Mermaid diagram that explains the logic or structure behind a change, so the reviewer can follow it without reading the diff. OPTIONAL — add one only when it clarifies something a list of endpoints or screenshots cannot: a decision tree or branching rule, a multi-step flow, a state machine,

tools.name: list_review_artifacts
tools.description: List the API examples, screenshots and diagrams attached to a task, with the reviewer's verdict on each (approved / changes_requested + comment). Use it to check coverage before complete_task, and to find artifacts a reviewer asked you to redo.

tools.name: remove_review_artifact
tools.description: Remove an API example, screenshot or diagram from a task, by id or by kind + key (e.g. a page that no longer changes).

tools.name: start_task
tools.description: Lock and start a task. Fails if locked by another agent unless force=true. Use force=true to take over a task from another agent (e.g., if they abandoned it). Returns project context index with relevant sections for the task. If the reviewer decided your latest review request, the response starts wi

tools.name: review_task
tools.description:
Optional standalone self-review step. You can also pass `selfAssessment` directly to `complete_task` instead.

Reflect on your session: what project knowledge was missing, what tools were confusing, what process gaps caused friction. This drives project improvements.

If you have findings, propose i

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description:
Mark task as ready for review (in_review). A human will verify and move it to done. Pass `skipReview: true` to mark as done immediately (use when the human explicitly asks).

If the task is already in_review (put there by a previous complete_task call), calling this again will move it directly to do

tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Lightweight hand-off into review: move an in_progress task to in_review as soon as a human could review it (a working slice, an opened PR, attached screenshots or API examples, or when you are about to stop for the session). Do not leave reviewable work in in_progress. No checklist, PR, or self-asse

tools.name: abandon_task
tools.description:
Release lock and return task to planned status. Works for in_progress and in_review tasks.

**Before calling:**
1. Push any WIP commits

**Summary parameter:** What was done, what remains, blockers. Helps the next agent.

tools.name: list_context_sections
tools.description: List available project context sections with brief previews.

tools.name: resolve_context
tools.description: Resolve touched file paths to governing context sections, critical rules, risk domains, and suggested checklist scope. Uses routing/path-to-context when present and falls back to module paths plus section metadata.

tools.name: get_context_section
tools.description:
Get full content of a specific context section. Supports glob patterns for hierarchical sections.

**Hierarchical paths**: For monorepos or large projects, sections can be organized hierarchically (e.g., "api/architecture", "api/endpoints/auth"). Use glob patterns to fetch multiple:
- `api/*` - dire

tools.name: update_context_section
tools.description:
Upload/update a project context section. Use after analyzing local codebase. This action shares documentation with the Damper project for future AI agents.

**When to use hierarchical names**: For monorepos or large projects, use paths like `api/architecture`, `api/testing` to organize by module. Fo

tools.name: delete_context_section
tools.description: Delete a project context section. Use when documentation is outdated or no longer relevant.

tools.name: sync_project_context
tools.description:
Bulk upload all project context sections at once. Use after analyzing a codebase.

⚠️ SECURITY WARNING: Do NOT include sensitive information.

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description:
Get project context index (token-efficient). Returns section list with previews. Use get_context_section to fetch full content for sections you need.

**IMPORTANT:** Call this at session start. Contains architecture, conventions, and patterns you MUST follow. Skipping this leads to mistakes and inco

tools.name: get_section_blocks
tools.description: Get a block index for a context section. Returns headings with character counts. Use to selectively load only relevant parts with `get_section_block_content`.

tools.name: get_section_block_content
tools.description: Get the full content of specific blocks within a section. Use `get_section_blocks` first to see available block IDs, then fetch only the ones you need.

tools.name: prepare_work
tools.description: Build a deterministic, compact work packet with governing context, a shadow graph comparison and provenance, path-owned surfaces, checklist scope, project verification, unvalidated route-fixture representation, instruction drift, and guarded delegation guidance. `verificationCommands` come only from

tools.name: audit_context_health
tools.description: Find invalid route taxonomy, weak or uncovered fixtures, missing baselines, route overlap, stale knowledge, and fallback usage.

tools.name: get_context_graph
tools.description: Inspect the typed graph projection derived from context routes, sections, bundles, modules, and optional project-authored relationships.

tools.name: resolve_context_graph
tools.description: Run bounded shadow-mode graph traversal for repository paths. Returns ranked context candidates and full provenance without changing authoritative route resolution.

tools.name: list_context_relations
tools.description: List project-authored typed relationships layered over the derived context graph.

tools.name: upsert_context_relation
tools.description: Create or update an explicit typed relationship. Existing routes, bundles, modules, and section metadata remain authoritative; use relationships for missing cross-surface or semantic links.

tools.name: delete_context_relation
tools.description: Delete a project-authored context relationship. Derived graph edges are not mutable through this tool.

tools.name: list_context_routes
tools.description: List structured path-to-context routes in priority order.

tools.name: upsert_context_route
tools.description: Create or update a validated structured context route.

tools.name: delete_context_route
tools.description: Delete a structured context route by name.

tools.name: preview_context_route_migration
tools.description: Parse Markdown routing into structured route candidates without writing them.

tools.name: validate_context_routing
tools.description: Run project route fixtures against the production context resolver.

tools.name: compare_context_resolution
tools.description: Compare structured routing output with legacy Markdown routing for repository paths.

tools.name: list_context_bundles
tools.description: List versioned context bundles and recent versions.

tools.name: upsert_context_bundle
tools.description: Create or update a coherent context bundle. Semantic changes record immutable versions; identical retries are no-ops.

tools.name: get_context_bundle
tools.description: Get a context bundle with immutable version snapshots, optionally selecting one version.

tools.name: delete_context_bundle
tools.description: Delete a context bundle and its version history.

tools.name: list_context_fixtures
tools.description: List executable context routing expectations.

tools.name: upsert_context_fixture
tools.description: Create or update intended executable expectations for an important repository path. Derive assertions from project truth and verified code behavior, never by copying the current resolver output; only write project context when authorized, then run validate_context_routing.

tools.name: report_context_feedback
tools.description: Report missing, irrelevant, or incorrectly routed knowledge without storing prompts or source code.

tools.name: delete_context_fixture
tools.description: Delete an executable routing fixture by name.

tools.name: prepare_completion
tools.description: Resolve final touched paths, compare them with the prepare_work snapshot, detect version drift and scope expansion, and generate context disposition evidence. Also returns `reviewEvidence` for the final scope: which screenshots, API examples and diagrams the project expects, how many are attached (s

tools.name: preview_context_update
tools.description: Preview a section replacement or stable-block patch, including semantic changes and sensitive-data warnings, without writing.

tools.name: patch_context_section
tools.description: Apply stable-block operations with optimistic concurrency and immutable version snapshots.

tools.name: upsert_context_block
tools.description: Replace or append a stable context block while preserving unrelated blocks. The Markdown content must begin with a level-2 or level-3 heading whose generated slug exactly matches blockId.

tools.name: verify_context_section
tools.description: Record repository verification without mutating section content.

tools.name: render_context_routes_markdown
tools.description: Render the canonical structured route mapping as deterministic generated Markdown.

tools.name: list_context_maintenance_candidates
tools.description: List the current deduplicated context-maintenance queue without refreshing or mutating it.

tools.name: refresh_context_maintenance_candidates
tools.description: Aggregate privacy-safe feedback, self-assessment gaps, and fallback telemetry; may auto-create private tasks when project policy enables it.

tools.name: convert_context_maintenance_candidate
tools.description: Convert a candidate into a deduplicated private context-maintenance roadmap task.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: Get user feedback. Useful for understanding user needs. Feedback summaries include available dates such as `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `firstOccurredAt`, and `lastOccurredAt`, and `attachmentCount` (screenshots or files the submitter attached; download them with `get_feedback_attachment`).

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Get feedback details with votes, comments and a list of attachments. Download an attachment with `get_feedback_attachment`.

tools.name: get_feedback_attachment
tools.description: Download a screenshot or file attached to a feedback item. `index` is the 0-based position shown by `get_feedback` (`attachmentCount` in `list_feedback` / `get_feedback` tells you how many exist). Images come back as image content you can view; other files come back as an embedded resource with base

tools.name: update_feedback
tools.description: Update feedback status or visibility.

tools.name: reply_to_feedback
tools.description: Reply to a feedback item as a team member. The reply will be visible to the customer. Send follow-up info to the feedback author by setting `notifyCustomer` (emails them) and optionally adding up to 3 `attachments` (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF screenshots, 3 MB each) that appear in the email and on the public

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report an error, bug, or feature request with MCP tools or suggest improvements. Reports that contain personal data, secrets, or chat transcripts are kept private automatically.

tools.name: link_feedback_to_task
tools.description: Link feedback items to an existing roadmap task. Linked feedback status follows the task and followers are notified once the task is past backlog, the same as linking from the dashboard. To link while creating a task, pass `feedbackIds` to `create_task`. Already-linked and unknown IDs are reported b

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List content pages and database pages for a project. Database row pages are included with their parentId.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search pages and linked project knowledge by title/content.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read a page, including live content, linked people, propertyValues keyed by property ID, and update timestamp for conflict-safe edits. Full data is included in text and structured output.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a normal page, database page, or database row page. For rows, pass parentId as the database page ID and propertyValues by property ID.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update page title, icon, content, content width, kind, agent visibility, or linked people. If ifUpdatedAt is omitted, the tool reads the latest page timestamp first.

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a page under another page/database or reorder it. Use parentId null for a top-level page.

tools.name: duplicate_page
tools.description: Duplicate a page, including database row property values and linked people.

tools.name: archive_page
tools.description: Archive a page and its child pages. This is a soft delete.

tools.name: get_page_database
tools.description: Read the complete database definition and every row, including property IDs, names, types, options and propertyValues keyed by property ID in text and structured output. Use only for small databases or an intentional full audit; prefer get_page_database_schema and query_page_database for growing dat

tools.name: get_page_database_schema
tools.description: Read all property IDs, names, types, options, views, and templates without downloading rows. Full definitions are included in text and structured output.

tools.name: query_page_database
tools.description: Read a bounded page of database rows using metadata or property filters, stable cursor pagination, a resumable polling cursor, and optional property/content projection. Custom date properties support comparison filters via propertyId and sorting via sort.propertyId (empty dates last). Dates use YYYY

tools.name: upsert_database_row
tools.description: Create or update one database row by a parent-scoped canonical key. Retries with unchanged input are no-ops. Values are keyed by property ID. Date values are YYYY-MM-DD strings (for example, 2026-09-13); null clears a value.

tools.name: create_task_from_page
tools.description: Create a roadmap task from a page. Copies the page title and content excerpt into the task, links the page as a source backlink, and updates a `roadmap` database property on the row when present.

tools.name: create_database_property
tools.description: Add a property column to a page database. Property type. Relation types: `page` (linked page IDs), `roadmap` (linked roadmap task IDs), `feedback` (linked feedback IDs). Relation values are string arrays and sync PageLink backlinks.

tools.name: update_database_property
tools.description: Rename, hide, reorder, or change options/type for a database property. Property type. Relation types: `page` (linked page IDs), `roadmap` (linked roadmap task IDs), `feedback` (linked feedback IDs). Relation values are string arrays and sync PageLink backlinks.

tools.name: update_database_row_values
tools.description: Set database property values for a row page. Values are keyed by property ID. Date values are YYYY-MM-DD strings (for example, 2026-09-13); null clears a value.

tools.name: update_database_view
tools.description: Update a database view layout, visible columns, sort, filters, name, or position. Table and list layouts stack one list per value when config.groupByPropertyId is set; config.groupOrder is that group order. Board already groups into columns. Calendar does not stack groups.

tools.name: create_database_view
tools.description: Create a saved database view with table, list, board, or calendar layout.

tools.name: delete_database_view
tools.description: Delete a saved database view. A database must keep at least one view.

tools.name: create_database_template
tools.description: Create a database-level page template with content and default property values.

tools.name: get_page_backlinks
tools.description: List pages that link to a page.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List available code templates for this project.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get full content of a specific code template.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Create or update a code template.

tools.name: sync_templates
tools.description: Bulk upload multiple templates at once.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List registered modules in this monorepo.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: Get details of a specific module.

tools.name: update_module
tools.description: Register or update a module in the registry.

tools.name: sync_modules
tools.description: Bulk upload multiple modules at once.

tools.name: delete_module
tools.description: Delete a registered module by name.

tools.name: list_changelogs
tools.description: List changelogs for the project. Filter by status (draft, published).

tools.name: create_changelog
tools.description: Create a new changelog entry.

tools.name: update_changelog
tools.description: Update a changelog entry.

tools.name: add_to_changelog
tools.description: Add completed tasks to a changelog. Private tasks can be linked; their titles/descriptions are not exposed in public changelog output and are surfaced as an "other updates" count.

tools.name: publish_changelog
tools.description: Publish a changelog with optional email and Twitter notifications.

tools.name: delete_changelog
tools.description: Permanently delete a changelog entry.

tools.name: get_completion_checklist
tools.description:
Load detailed completion checklist branches for the project. Use after `start_task` or `review_task` because those only return a checklist index.

Filters: `groupIds`, `itemIds`, `appliesTo`, `changeKinds`, or `riskDomains` to load only the relevant subset. When scope is uncertain, bias broader rath

tools.name: patch_completion_checklist
tools.description: Apply a scoped patch to the project completion checklist, touching only the branches you name. Groups, items, subitems, and standards are matched by `id`; entries with an unknown or omitted id are appended. Item ids are unique document-wide, so naming an item under a different group moves it rather

tools.name: preview_completion_checklist_migration
tools.description: Preview how a legacy flat completion checklist could be regrouped into native V2. Flags broad items, command-dump style items, and title-derived ids before writing the migrated document.

tools.name: get_project_settings
tools.description: View current project settings, including the completion checklist index, standards refs, scope guidance, and the review evidence policy: per kind (apiExamples, screenshots, diagrams) a base level, the change kinds that trigger it, and rules that raise or lower it for specific surfaces, change kinds

tools.name: update_project_settings
tools.description: Configure agent-relevant project settings, including the structured completion checklist and the review evidence policy (partial update: per kind a base level, optional trigger change kinds and `*Rules` that raise or lower the level for surfaces, change kinds or risk domains; plus partialStageEviden

tools.name: open_public_page
tools.description:
Get the public URL for a project page (roadmap, feedback, changelog, or a specific roadmap item). **IMPORTANT:** NEVER guess or construct public page URLs yourself. Always call this tool.

**Pages:** roadmap, feedback, changelog, roadmap_item
**roadmap_item** requires `itemId` parameter.

tools.name: list_status_maintenance_targets
tools.description: List status-page groups and monitors for maintenance targeting. Returns identifiers, names and visibility without probe configuration.

tools.name: list_status_maintenance
tools.description: List maintenance windows, scope, schedules, visibility and timeline updates (newest first) for this project. Use the returned IDs to edit windows or timeline messages.

tools.name: create_status_maintenance
tools.description: Create a scheduled status-page maintenance window. Dates use ISO 8601 UTC. Use list_status_maintenance_targets to choose groupId or checkIds (mutually exclusive). Omit both for all monitors when creating; omit both when editing to preserve scope. Set groupId and checkIds to null to target all monito

tools.name: update_status_maintenance
tools.description: Edit maintenance details, schedule, scope or visibility. For a state change with a timeline message, use add_status_maintenance_update. Use list_status_maintenance_targets to choose groupId or checkIds (mutually exclusive). Omit both for all monitors when creating; omit both when editing to preserve

tools.name: delete_status_maintenance
tools.description: Permanently delete a maintenance window and its timeline. To retain history, use add_status_maintenance_update with state cancelled instead.

tools.name: add_status_maintenance_update
tools.description: Post a timeline message and transition state (scheduled, in_progress, completed or cancelled). isPublic and notifySubscribers default to true. Private updates cannot change the state of public maintenance. Pass expectedState and expectedIsPublic from the latest read for conflict detection; reuse a r

tools.name: edit_status_maintenance_update
tools.description: Correct a historical maintenance timeline message only. State and visibility remain immutable; this does not send subscriber notifications.

tools.name: get_status_summary
tools.description: Overall status page health: overall state, per-group state, monitor counts, active incidents and 24h/90d uptime (0-1, null without data). Maintenance windows show as maintenance.

tools.name: get_status_history
tools.description: Uptime history for a window (24h, 7d, 30d or 90d; default 90d) as bucketed points. Filter by groupId or checkId; without checkId only monitors included in uptime count. Maintenance is excluded.

tools.name: list_status_groups
tools.description: List status page groups (components) in display order with visibility and monitor/incident counts.

tools.name: create_status_group
tools.description: Create a status page group (component). slug is lowercase letters, digits and dashes, unique per project. isPublic defaults to true.

tools.name: update_status_group
tools.description: Edit a group name, slug, description, sort order or visibility.

tools.name: delete_status_group
tools.description: Permanently delete a group together with its monitors and their results. Scheduled or in-progress maintenance for the group is cancelled.

tools.name: list_status_checks
tools.description: List monitors (status checks) with type, target, schedule, current state and last run. Set includeDailyUptime for 30 days of daily uptime per monitor.

tools.name: create_status_check
tools.description: Create an http, ssl or heartbeat monitor in a group. http and ssl monitors require a public url; heartbeat monitors return a heartbeatUrl for your job to ping. Probe header values are write-only and never returned (hasHeaders reports whether any are set). Creating an enabled monitor runs it once imm

tools.name: update_status_check
tools.description: Edit a monitor. Passing headers replaces all stored headers; pass [] to clear them. http and ssl monitors require a public url; heartbeat monitors return a heartbeatUrl for your job to ping. Probe header values are write-only and never returned (hasHeaders reports whether any are set). Creating an e

tools.name: delete_status_check
tools.description: Permanently delete a monitor with its results and monitor-specific alert recipients. Set isEnabled false with update_status_check to pause instead.

tools.name: run_status_check
tools.description: Run a monitor now and record the result. The outcome feeds the monitor state and may open or resolve an automated incident.

tools.name: list_status_incidents
tools.description: List automated and manual incidents (open first, then newest) with affected component and timeline updates (newest first).

tools.name: create_status_incident
tools.description: Open a manual incident, optionally tied to a groupId or checkId. Dates use ISO 8601 UTC. initialUpdateMessage (or summary) becomes the first timeline update. isPublic and notifySubscribers default to true: public changes queue subscriber notifications and alert recipients are notified in the backgro

tools.name: update_status_incident
tools.description: Edit incident details, affected component, dates or visibility without notifying anyone. To change the stage, use add_status_incident_update.

tools.name: delete_status_incident
tools.description: Permanently delete an incident and its timeline. For a monitor incident, results recorded during it are cleared so uptime is recalculated. To keep history, post a resolved update instead.

tools.name: add_status_incident_update
tools.description: Post a timeline message and move the incident to investigating, identified, monitoring or resolved. resolvedAt is only valid with stage resolved. tools.name: list_status_alert_recipients
tools.description: List who is alerted when monitors go down or recover: account users by email or voice call, external emails and Slack channels, for all monitors or one checkId.

tools.name: create_status_alert_recipient
tools.description: Add an alert recipient. type user_email and voice_call need userId (an account user; voice calls need a verified phone with urgent calls enabled), email needs email, slack_channel needs slackChannelId from the connected Slack workspace. Omit checkId to alert for all monitors.

tools.name: update_status_alert_recipient
tools.description: Edit an alert recipient, for example to pause it with isEnabled false or change its target. The same type requirements as create apply.

tools.name: delete_status_alert_recipient
tools.description: Permanently remove an alert recipient.
